title: Insured Plan of Care: Measuring an Overstated Coinsurance Charge
content:
**Patient Accounts Manual — Insured Plan of Care, coinsurance review.**

**Clause.** The coinsurance correction is the reviewed coinsurance charge less the supported coinsurance share, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent. The supported coinsurance share is the coinsurance percentage on file applied once to the reviewed visit's allowed amount, rounded half up to the cent.

**Which charge and which visit.** The charge reviewed is the coinsurance charge posted most recently on the plan of care, earlier coinsurance charges having been reviewed when they were posted. The visit reviewed is the billed visit whose date of service is the date of service of that charge; its allowed amount is the payer allowed amount recorded on that billed visit.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Reviewed coinsurance charge | Allowed amount of the reviewed visit | Coinsurance percentage on file | Supported share | Correction |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $45.00 | $120.00 | 20% | $24.00 | $21.00 |
| $25.00 | $97.37 | 20% | $19.47 (19.474 rounded half up) | $5.53 |
| $18.00 | $120.00 | 20% | $24.00 | $0.00 (never below zero) |

**Reading the rows.** In the first row the coinsurance percentage acts once on $120.00, giving $24.00; the charge of $45.00 less $24.00 leaves $21.00 to correct. In the third row the charge is already below the supported share, so the correction is zero rather than negative.

**Identifying the charge — hypothetical history.** Coinsurance charges were posted on a plan on 2026-02-12 (date of service 2026-01-28) and on 2026-03-05 (date of service 2026-02-17). The charge reviewed is the one posted on 2026-03-05, and the visit reviewed is the visit billed for 2026-02-17.
